cards.t: A submarine is rowed under the Thames
cards.fact: A submarine was rowed under the Thames about ten years after Galileo first spotted Jupiter's moons.
h: Cornelis Drebbel tested the first navigable submarine around 1620.
Drebbel's submarine went under the Thames around the time the Mayflower sailed.
